notes.title: Demo Diary #1 - Steam Next Fest - Demo available !
notes.content:
Hello future employees!

Today begins the Steam Next Fest, and it is with great pleasure that I announce the release of the demo of “Panic in Store!” !!

This demo will be available from today, for free, until the game is released in early access.

Here's what this demo includes:

- A campaign mode playable solo, including the first world, i.e. the first 5 levels of the game.
- Steam integration, allowing you to see your Steam nickname/profile image during different levels of the game.
- Twitch integration, so that streamers can have fun, viewers will be able to have their nickname above the heads of some of the game's naughty NPCs.
- Character customization, very limited for the moment, but will be greatly expanded when the game is released.
- Customization of housing, the game lobby, your apartment. For now, you can simply modify the sofa and bed, but other customizations will be available soon.
- A first tutorial to understand the keys of the game.
- Some additional features described in game.

Don't hesitate to give your feedback and put the game on your wishlist if you like the game, this greatly helps with visibility.

Remember that the customer is king,
The developer.
